fullText.simplified:
三、往前走

    小白被大雕抓走了，大雕会吃了他吗？饭饭难过极了，坐在路边大声地哭。
    天很快又黑了。哭了一天的饭饭望着脚下黑黑的小路，想起了小黄猫。
    “小黄猫，如果你是我，你会怎么办？”
    没有人回答他。过了一会儿，他在心里听到两个声音。
    “往前走，饭饭，别害怕。”这是小黄猫的声音。
    “小猫，你害怕了吗？”这是小白的声音。
    饭饭不哭了。他站起来，开始往前走。
    我不能总是哭！小白打小黄猫的时候，我没有帮小黄猫，我一个人跑了。这一次，我不会再跑了，我要帮小白！大雕抓了小白，但没有马上吃小白。他抓着小白往雪山去了，如果我现在去雪山，是不是还能找到小白？如果再跑快一些，是不是就能在大雕吃小白以前找到小白？饭饭一边想着，一边飞快地跑着。
    他不再休息，白天跑，晚上也跑；下雨时跑，刮风时也跑。他跑得越来越快。
    三天后，他来到了雪山脚下。
    雪山真高啊！雪山上的雪真厚啊！从下往上看，只看得到厚厚的白雪，看不到路。他喝了一点儿雪水，然后开始爬山。爬着爬着，他就明白为什么小白说雪山上的路不好走了，因为这儿其实没有路。雪山上只有两个东西，雪和石头。饭饭一会儿走在雪上，一会儿走在石头上。他不能跑，只能小心地走。他越走越累，觉得这真是太难了。
    太阳出来了，太阳下山了，时间慢慢过去了。有几只鸟儿在天上飞过，但没有那只大雕。他去哪儿了？饭饭真想再见到他，他要问问他，他把小白抓到哪儿去了？
    后来，山上的风越刮越大，鸟儿们都不见了。高高的雪山上就只有饭饭一个人了。
fullText.traditional:
三、往前走

    小白被大鵰抓走了，大鵰會吃了他嗎？飯飯難過極了，坐在路邊大聲地哭。
    天很快又黑了。哭了一天的飯飯望著腳下黑黑的小路，想起了小黃貓。
    “小黃貓，如果你是我，你會怎麼辦？”
    沒有人回答他。過了一會兒，他在心裡聽到兩個聲音。
    “往前走，飯飯，別害怕。”這是小黃貓的聲音。
    “小貓，你害怕了嗎？”這是小白的聲音。
    飯飯不哭了。他站起來，開始往前走。
    我不能總是哭！小白打小黃貓的時候，我沒有幫小黃貓，我一個人跑了。這一次，我不會再跑了，我要幫小白！大鵰抓了小白，但沒有馬上吃小白。他抓著小白往雪山去了，如果我現在去雪山，是不是還能找到小白？如果再跑快一些，是不是就能在大鵰吃小白以前找到小白？飯飯一邊想著，一邊飛快地跑著。
    他不再休息，白天跑，晚上也跑；下雨時跑，颳風時也跑。他跑得越來越快。
    三天後，他來到了雪山腳下。
    雪山真高啊！雪山上的雪真厚啊！從下往上看，只看得到厚厚的白雪，看不到路。他喝了一點兒雪水，然後開始爬山。爬著爬著，他就明白為什麼小白說雪山上的路不好走了，因為這兒其實沒有路。雪山上只有兩個東西，雪和石頭。飯飯一會兒走在雪上，一會兒走在石頭上。他不能跑，只能小心地走。他越走越累，覺得這真是太難了。
    太陽出來了，太陽下山了，時間慢慢過去了。有幾隻鳥兒在天上飛過，但沒有那隻大鵰。他去哪兒了？飯飯真想再見到他，他要問問他，他把小白抓到哪兒去了？
    後來，山上的風越颳越大，鳥兒們都不見了。高高的雪山上就只有飯飯一個人了。

sentences.traditional: 小白被大鵰抓走了，大鵰會吃了他嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái bèi dà diāo zhuā zǒu le dà diāo huì chī le tā ma
sentences.english: Little Bai was taken away by the big eagle. Would the big eagle eat him?

sentences.simplified: 饭饭难过极了，坐在路边大声地哭。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯難過極了，坐在路邊大聲地哭。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn nán guò jí le zuò zài lù biān dà shēng de kū
sentences.english: Fanfan was extremely upset. He sat by the roadside and cried loudly.

sentences.simplified: 天很快又黑了。
sentences.traditional: 天很快又黑了。
sentences.pinyin: tiān hěn kuài yòu hēi le
sentences.english: The sky quickly turned dark again.

sentences.simplified: 哭了一天的饭饭望着脚下黑黑的小路，想起了小黄猫。
sentences.traditional: 哭了一天的飯飯望著腳下黑黑的小路，想起了小黃貓。
sentences.pinyin: kū le yì tiān de fàn fàn wàng zhe jiǎo xià hēi hēi de xiǎo lù xiǎng qǐ le xiǎo huáng māo
sentences.english: Fanfan, who had been crying all day, looked at the dark path beneath his feet and thought of the little yellow cat.

sentences.simplified: “小黄猫，如果你是我，你会怎么办？”
sentences.traditional: “小黃貓，如果你是我，你會怎麼辦？”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo rú guǒ nǐ shì wǒ nǐ huì zěn me bàn
sentences.english: “Little yellow cat, if you were me, what would you do?”

sentences.simplified: 没有人回答他。过了一会儿，他在心里听到两个声音。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人回答他。過了一會兒，他在心裡聽到兩個聲音。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén huí dá tā guò le yí huì'r tā zài xīn li tīng dào liǎng ge shēng yīn
sentences.english: No one answered him. After a while, he heard two voices in his head.

sentences.simplified: “往前走，饭饭，别害怕。”这是小黄猫的声音。
sentences.traditional: “往前走，飯飯，別害怕。”這是小黃貓的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: wǎng qián zǒu fàn fàn bié hài pà zhè shì xiǎo huáng māo de shēng yīn
sentences.english: “Walk forward, Fanfan, don’t be afraid.” This was the little yellow cat’s voice.

sentences.simplified: “小猫，你害怕了吗？”这是小白的声音。
sentences.traditional: “小貓，你害怕了嗎？”這是小白的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo māo nǐ hài pà le ma zhè shì xiǎo bái de shēng yīn
sentences.english: “Little cat, are you afraid?” This was Little Bai’s voice.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭不哭了。他站起来，开始往前走。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯不哭了。他站起來，開始往前走。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn bù kū le tā zhàn qǐ lái kāi shǐ wǎng qián zǒu
sentences.english: Fanfan stopped crying. He stood up and started walking forward.

sentences.simplified: 我不能总是哭！
sentences.traditional: 我不能總是哭！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù néng zǒng shì kū
sentences.english: I can’t keep crying!

sentences.simplified: 小白打小黄猫的时候，我没有帮小黄猫，我一个人跑了。
sentences.traditional: 小白打小黃貓的時候，我沒有幫小黃貓，我一個人跑了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái dǎ xiǎo huáng māo de shí hou wǒ méi yǒu bāng xiǎo huáng māo wǒ yí ge rén pǎo le
sentences.english: When Little Bai was hitting the little yellow cat, I didn’t help the little yellow cat. I ran away by myself.

sentences.simplified: 这一次，我不会再跑了，我要帮小白！
sentences.traditional: 這一次，我不會再跑了，我要幫小白！
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì wǒ bú huì zài pǎo le wǒ yào bāng xiǎo bái
sentences.english: This time, I won’t run away. I’m going to help Little Bai!

sentences.simplified: 大雕抓了小白，但没有马上吃小白。
sentences.traditional: 大鵰抓了小白，但沒有馬上吃小白。
sentences.pinyin: dà diāo zhuā le xiǎo bái dàn méi yǒu mǎ shàng chī xiǎo bái
sentences.english: The big eagle took Little Bai away but didn’t eat him right away.

sentences.simplified: 他抓着小白往雪山去了，如果我现在去雪山，是不是还能找到小白？
sentences.traditional: 他抓著小白往雪山去了，如果我現在去雪山，是不是還能找到小白？
sentences.pinyin: tā zhuā zhe xiǎo bái wǎng xuě shān qù le rú guǒ wǒ xiàn zài qù xuě shān shì bú shì hái néng zhǎo dào xiǎo bái
sentences.english: He took Little Bai to the snowy mountain. If I go to the snowy mountain now, can I still find Little Bai?

sentences.simplified: 如果再跑快一些，是不是就能在大雕吃小白以前找到小白？
sentences.traditional: 如果再跑快一些，是不是就能在大鵰吃小白以前找到小白？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zài pǎo kuài yì xiē shì bú shì jiù néng zài dà diāo chī xiǎo bái yǐ qián zhǎo dào xiǎo bái
sentences.english: If I run a bit faster, can I find Little Bai before the big eagle eats him?

sentences.simplified: 饭饭一边想着，一边飞快地跑着。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯一邊想著，一邊飛快地跑著。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn yì biān xiǎng zhe yì biān fēi kuài de pǎo zhe
sentences.english: Fanfan thought about this while running quickly.

sentences.simplified: 他不再休息，白天跑，晚上也跑；下雨时跑，刮风时也跑。他跑得越来越快。
sentences.traditional: 他不再休息，白天跑，晚上也跑；下雨時跑，颳風時也跑。他跑得越來越快。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú zài xiū xi bái tiān pǎo wǎn shang yě pǎo xià yǔ shí pǎo guā fēng shí yě pǎo tā pǎo de yuè lái yuè kuài
sentences.english: He no longer rested. He ran during the day and during the night, through the rain and the wind. He ran faster and faster.

sentences.simplified: 三天后，他来到了雪山脚下。
sentences.traditional: 三天後，他來到了雪山腳下。
sentences.pinyin: sān tiān hòu tā lái dào le xuě shān jiǎo xià
sentences.english: Three days later, he arrived at the foot of the snowy mountain.

sentences.simplified: 雪山真高啊！雪山上的雪真厚啊！
sentences.traditional: 雪山真高啊！雪山上的雪真厚啊！
sentences.pinyin: xuě shān zhēn gāo a xuě shān shang de xuě zhēn hòu a
sentences.english: The snowy mountain was really high! The snow on the snowy mountain was really thick!

sentences.simplified: 从下往上看，只看得到厚厚的白雪，看不到路。
sentences.traditional: 從下往上看，只看得到厚厚的白雪，看不到路。
sentences.pinyin: cóng xià wǎng shàng kàn zhǐ kàn de dào hòu hòu de bái xuě kàn bú dào lù
sentences.english: Looking up from below, you could only see thick, white snow, and you could not see the road.

sentences.simplified: 他喝了一点儿雪水，然后开始爬山。
sentences.traditional: 他喝了一點兒雪水，然後開始爬山。
sentences.pinyin: tā hē le yì diǎn'r xuě shuǐ rán hòu kāi shǐ pá shān
sentences.english: He drank a little snow water and then started climbing the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 爬着爬着，他就明白为什么小白说雪山上的路不好走了，
sentences.traditional: 爬著爬著，他就明白為什麼小白說雪山上的路不好走了，
sentences.pinyin: pá zhe pá zhe tā jiù míng bai wèi shén me xiǎo bái shuō xuě shān shang de lù bù hǎo zǒu le
sentences.english: As he climbed, he understood why Little Bai said that the road on the snowy mountain was not easy to walk up.

sentences.simplified: 因为这儿其实没有路。雪山上只有两个东西，雪和石头。
sentences.traditional: 因為這兒其實沒有路。雪山上只有兩個東西，雪和石頭。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè‘r qí shí méi yǒu lù xuě shān shang zhǐ yǒu liǎng ge dōng xi xuě hé shí tou
sentences.english: This was because there was actually no road there. On the snowy mountain, there were only two things: snow and rocks.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭一会儿走在雪上，一会儿走在石头上。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯一會兒走在雪上，一會兒走在石頭上。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn yí huì'r zǒu zài xuě shang yí huì'r zǒu zài shí tou shang
sentences.english: Fanfan walked on the snow for a while, then on the rocks for a while.

sentences.simplified: 他不能跑，只能小心地走。
sentences.traditional: 他不能跑，只能小心地走。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù néng pǎo zhǐ néng xiǎo xīn de zǒu
sentences.english: He could not run. He could only walk carefully.

sentences.simplified: 他越走越累，觉得这真是太难了。
sentences.traditional: 他越走越累，覺得這真是太難了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yuè zǒu yuè lèi jué de zhè zhēn shi tài nán le
sentences.english: The more he walked, the more tired he became. He felt that this was really too difficult.

sentences.simplified: 太阳出来了，太阳下山了，时间慢慢过去了。
sentences.traditional: 太陽出來了，太陽下山了，時間慢慢過去了。
sentences.pinyin: tài yáng chū lái le tài yáng xià shān le shí jiān màn man guò qù le
sentences.english: The sun rose, and the sun set. Time passed by slowly.

sentences.simplified: 有几只鸟儿在天上飞过，但没有那只大雕。他去哪儿了？
sentences.traditional: 有幾隻鳥兒在天上飛過，但沒有那隻大鵰。他去哪兒了？
sentences.pinyin: yǒu jǐ zhī niǎo'r zài tiān shàng fēi guò dàn méi yǒu nà zhī dà diāo tā qù nǎ'r le
sentences.english: Several birds flew across the sky, but the big eagle was not among them. Where did he go?

sentences.simplified: 饭饭真想再见到他，他要问问他，他把小白抓到哪儿去了？
sentences.traditional: 飯飯真想再見到他，他要問問他，他把小白抓到哪兒去了？
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn zhēn xiǎng zài jiàn dào tā tā yào wèn wen tā tā bǎ xiǎo bái zhuā dào nǎ'r qù le
sentences.english: Fanfan really wanted to see him again. He wanted to ask him, where did he take Little Bai?

sentences.simplified: 后来，山上的风越刮越大，鸟儿们都不见了。
sentences.traditional: 後來，山上的風越颳越大，鳥兒們都不見了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái shān shang de fēng yuè guā yuè dà niǎo'r men dōu bú jiàn le
sentences.english: Later, the wind on the mountain grew stronger and stronger, and the birds all disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 高高的雪山上就只有饭饭一个人了。
sentences.traditional: 高高的雪山上就只有飯飯一個人了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo gāo de xuě shān shang jiù zhǐ yǒu fàn fàn yí ge rén le
sentences.english: On the high snowy mountain, Fanfan was the only one left.

sentence_translations: (3) Walk Forward
Little Bai was taken away by the big eagle. Would the big eagle eat him?
Fanfan was extremely upset. He sat by the roadside and cried loudly.
The sky quickly turned dark again.
Fanfan, who had been crying all day, looked at the dark path beneath his feet and thought of the little yellow cat.
“Little yellow cat, if you were me, what would you do?”
No one answered him. After a while, he heard two voices in his head.
“Walk forward, Fanfan, don’t be afraid.” This was the little yellow cat’s voice.
“Little cat, are you afraid?” This was Little Bai’s voice.
Fanfan stopped crying. He stood up and started walking forward.
I can’t keep crying!
When Little Bai was hitting the little yellow cat, I didn’t help the little yellow cat. I ran away by myself.
This time, I won’t run away. I’m going to help Little Bai!
The big eagle took Little Bai away but didn’t eat him right away.
He took Little Bai to the snowy mountain. If I go to the snowy mountain now, can I still find Little Bai?
If I run a bit faster, can I find Little Bai before the big eagle eats him?
Fanfan thought about this while running quickly.
He no longer rested. He ran during the day and during the night, through the rain and the wind. He ran faster and faster.
Three days later, he arrived at the foot of the snowy mountain.
The snowy mountain was really high! The snow on the snowy mountain was really thick!
Looking up from below, you could only see thick, white snow, and you could not see the road.
He drank a little snow water and then started climbing the mountain.
As he climbed, he understood why Little Bai said that the road on the snowy mountain was not easy to walk up.
This was because there was actually no road there. On the snowy mountain, there were only two things: snow and rocks.
Fanfan walked on the snow for a while, then on the rocks for a while.
He could not run. He could only walk carefully.
The more he walked, the more tired he became. He felt that this was really too difficult.
The sun rose, and the sun set. Time passed by slowly.
Several birds flew across the sky, but the big eagle was not among them. Where did he go?
Fanfan really wanted to see him again. He wanted to ask him, where did he take Little Bai?
Later, the wind on the mountain grew stronger and stronger, and the birds all disappeared.
On the high snowy mountain, Fanfan was the only one left.
